fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Paint looks glossy overall with good reflections on the hood and doors; seller says a full detail was just done
Light dust or film on the lower rear bumper and lower liftgate area
Driver seat leather shows creasing and some light scuffing on the side bolster
Floor mat and carpet look a bit dusty with some debris on the driver side
Headlight lenses look mostly clear with slight haze visible from the front
message: Hi, we saw your Jeep Liberty listing and it already looks well kept. If you want a final touch before showings, we could clean and condition the leather on the driver seat, freshen the floor mats and give the headlights a quick polish. We come to you. Would you like a quote?
